title: Connecting ideas between and within sentences
summary: Связующие слова для добавления, контраста, результата и пояснения (moreover, however, nevertheless, therefore, in other words и др.), их позиция и пунктуация, коррелятивные пары both ... and, neither ... nor, not only ... but also.
ru:
## Союз внутри предложения и связка между предложениями
Продвинутая речь строится на умении связывать мысли. Важно различать два типа слов:
- **Союзы** (and, but, so, yet, or, although, because) соединяют части **внутри одного предложения**.
- **Связующие наречия** (however, moreover, therefore, nevertheless, consequently) стоят **между предложениями** и отделяются запятой. Соединять ими два предложения одной запятой нельзя — получится «comma splice».
> ~~It was raining, however we went for a walk.~~
> → It was raining. **However**, we went for a walk. / It was raining**;** **however**, we went for a walk. / It was raining, **but** we went for a walk.

## Добавление информации
**Moreover, furthermore, in addition, what's more, besides, on top of that** — «кроме того». Moreover и furthermore формальнее, what's more и on top of that разговорнее.
> The software is free. **Moreover**, it runs on any system. — Программа бесплатна. Более того, она работает на любой системе.
**Besides** (кроме того) ≠ **beside** (рядом): *Besides being cheap, the hotel is close to the beach.* Для усиления: **not only ... but also** с инверсией: ***Not only did** she win, **but** she **also** broke the record.*

## Контраст
- **however, nevertheless, nonetheless, even so, still, yet** — «однако, тем не менее»: *The results looked promising. **Nevertheless**, further tests revealed a flaw.*
- **on the other hand, in contrast, by contrast** — сопоставление: *Some people love working from home. **On the other hand**, others miss the office.* Часто в паре: **on the one hand ... on the other hand**.
- **on the contrary** — не противопоставление, а **возражение**: *'Was the film boring?' — '**On the contrary**, it was fascinating.'*
- **instead** — «вместо этого»: *She didn't go out. **Instead**, she stayed at home.*
- ~~In the other hand~~ → **On** the other hand.

## Результат и следствие
**Therefore, consequently, as a result, hence, thus** — «поэтому, в результате». **Hence** и **thus** — самые формальные, часто без запятой. **So** — разговорный союз, соединяет внутри предложения: *It was late, **so** we left.*
> Sales fell sharply; **consequently**, the company cut 200 jobs.
Можно также использовать **which** для комментария ко всей ситуации: *The train was late, **which** made us miss the meeting.*

## Пояснение, пример, итог
- **in other words, that is (to say), i.e.** — переформулировка: *In other words, we have run out of money.*
- **for example, for instance, such as, including** — пример.
- **firstly, to begin with, then, subsequently, finally; in conclusion, to sum up** — порядок и итог.

## Позиция связующих слов
Связующие наречия (however, therefore, moreover и др.) могут стоять **в начале** или **в середине** предложения, выделяясь запятыми; **however** (а также nevertheless) — ещё и **в конце**:
> **However**, the plan has drawbacks. / The plan, **however**, has drawbacks. / The plan has drawbacks, **however**.
В середине (после подлежащего) звучит нейтрально и «письменно».

## Пары both ... and, either ... or, neither ... nor
После обеих частей пары должны стоять **одинаковые по форме** элементы: *She is **neither** rude **nor** unkind.* ~~Both the director or her deputy~~ → Both the director **and** her deputy.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Although it was cold, however we went swimming.~~ → не два контрастных слова: **Although** it was cold, we went swimming.
- ~~We were late, therefore we missed it.~~ → We were late; **therefore**, we missed it. / We were late, **so** we missed it.
en:
## Conjunctions within a sentence, linking adverbs between sentences
Good English connects ideas. There are two types of linkers:
- **Conjunctions** (and, but, so, yet, or, although, because) join parts **within one sentence**.
- **Linking adverbs** (however, moreover, therefore, nevertheless, consequently) connect **separate sentences** and are followed by a comma. You cannot join two sentences with only a comma and a linking adverb — that is a comma splice.
> ~~It was raining, however we went for a walk.~~
> → It was raining. **However**, we went for a walk. / It was raining**;** **however**, we went for a walk. / It was raining, **but** we went for a walk.

## Adding information
**Moreover, furthermore, in addition, what's more, besides, on top of that** mean 'also'. Moreover and furthermore are more formal; what's more and on top of that are more conversational.
> The software is free. **Moreover**, it runs on any system.
**Besides** (in addition) is different from **beside** (next to): *Besides being cheap, the hotel is close to the beach.* For emphasis use **not only ... but also** with inversion: ***Not only did** she win, **but** she **also** broke the record.*

## Contrast
- **however, nevertheless, nonetheless, even so, still, yet**: *The results looked promising. **Nevertheless**, further tests revealed a flaw.*
- **on the other hand, in contrast, by contrast** compare two things: *Some people love working from home. **On the other hand**, others miss the office.* Often paired with **on the one hand**.
- **on the contrary** rejects what was said: *'Was the film boring?' '**On the contrary**, it was fascinating.'*
- **instead**: *She didn't go out. **Instead**, she stayed at home.*
- ~~In the other hand~~ → **On** the other hand.

## Result
**Therefore, consequently, as a result, hence, thus** mean 'for this reason'. **Hence** and **thus** are the most formal. **So** is informal and joins clauses inside a sentence: *It was late, **so** we left.*
> Sales fell sharply; **consequently**, the company cut 200 jobs.
You can also comment on a whole situation with **which**: *The train was late, **which** made us miss the meeting.*

## Explaining, giving examples, concluding
- **in other words, that is (to say), i.e.** restate an idea.
- **for example, for instance, such as, including** give examples.
- **firstly, to begin with, then, subsequently, finally; in conclusion, to sum up** organise the text.

## Position of linking adverbs
Linking adverbs (however, therefore, moreover etc.) can come **at the start** or **in the middle** of a sentence; **however** (and nevertheless) can also come **at the end**:
> **However**, the plan has drawbacks. / The plan, **however**, has drawbacks. / The plan has drawbacks, **however**.

## both ... and, either ... or, neither ... nor
The two parts must have the **same form**: *She is **neither** rude **nor** unkind.* ~~Both the director or her deputy~~ → Both the director **and** her deputy.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Although it was cold, however we went swimming.~~ → use only one linker: **Although** it was cold, we went swimming.
- ~~We were late, therefore we missed it.~~ → We were late; **therefore**, we missed it. / We were late, **so** we missed it.
structure:
## Линкеры по значению
| Значение | Формальные | Нейтральные / разговорные |
|---|---|---|
| добавление | moreover, furthermore, in addition | also, besides, what's more |
| контраст | nevertheless, nonetheless, by contrast | however, still, even so, yet |
| результат | consequently, hence, thus, therefore | as a result, so |
| переформулировка | that is to say | in other words |
| пример | namely, in particular | for example, such as |
| итог | in conclusion | to sum up, in short |

## Пунктуация
| Конструкция | Пример |
|---|---|
| два предложения + линкер | It was late. However, we stayed. |
| точка с запятой + линкер | It was late; however, we stayed. |
| союз внутри предложения | It was late, but we stayed. |
| линкер в середине | We stayed, however, until midnight. |

## Формулы
> **Not only** + вспомогательный + подлежащее + V, **but** + подлежащее + **also** + V
> **both** A **and** B  ·  **either** A **or** B  ·  **neither** A **nor** B
> **..., which** + V (комментарий ко всей ситуации)
> **On the one hand** ..., **on the other hand** ...

exercises.title: Подберите связку
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее связующее слово или выражение (если возможны варианты — достаточно одного).
exercises.example: The initial results were promising. ___, further tests revealed a flaw. → **Nevertheless**

items.text: The initial results were promising. {{However|Nevertheless|Nonetheless|Yet|Still|Even so}}, further tests revealed a flaw.
The software is free. {{Moreover|Furthermore|In addition|What's more|Besides|On top of that|Also}}, it runs on any system.
Sales fell sharply; {{consequently|as a result|therefore|thus|hence}}, the company cut 200 jobs.
Some people love working from home. {{On the other hand|However|By contrast|In contrast}}, others miss the office.
'Was the film boring?' — '{{On the contrary}}, it was fascinating.'
I'd like to put it more simply. {{In other words|That is to say|That is|Put simply|Simply put|To put it simply}}, we have run out of money.
{{Not only}} did she win the race, but she also broke the record.
She didn't go to the party. {{Instead}}, she stayed at home and read.
{{Both}} the director {{and}} her deputy attended the meeting.
She is {{neither}} rude {{nor}} unkind; she is just shy.
The experiment failed. {{Hence|Thus|Therefore|Consequently|As a result}}, the team had to start again.
The flat is small; {{nevertheless|however|nonetheless|even so|still}}, it is very comfortable.
{{On the one hand}}, remote work saves time; on the other hand, it can be isolating.
Several countries, {{such as|including|like}} Norway and Sweden, have banned the practice.
{{To sum up|In conclusion|To conclude|In summary|In short|All in all}}, the project was a success despite early difficulties.
It rained all day; {{even so|nevertheless|nonetheless|still|however}}, we enjoyed the trip.

exercises.title: Выберите правильный вариант
exercises.instruction: Выберите связку, подходящую по смыслу и грамматике.

items.q: It was late, ___ we decided to stay.
items.why: Одна запятая допустима только с союзом — **so** (результат); however и moreover дали бы comma splice.

items.q: She is an excellent engineer. ___, she is a gifted teacher.
I didn't like the book. ___, my sister loved it.
The road was closed. ___, we had to take a detour.
Prices have risen. ___, demand has not fallen.
items.why: Неожиданный контраст (цены выросли, но спрос не упал) — **Nevertheless**.

items.q: 'Are you nervous?' '___, I feel quite relaxed.'
The plan has some drawbacks. It is, ___, the best option we have.
___ she was late, the meeting started on time.
items.why: Внутри одного предложения нужен союз **although**; nevertheless / however связывают отдельные предложения.

exercises.title: Найдите верное предложение
exercises.instruction: Только одно предложение правильное. Обратите внимание на пунктуацию.

options: The test was difficult, however most students passed.
The test was difficult; however, most students passed.
The test was difficult however, most students passed.
items.why: Перед линкером — точка с запятой (или точка), после — запятая; одна запятая даёт comma splice.

options: On the other hand, remote work can be isolating.
In the other hand, remote work can be isolating.
At the other hand, remote work can be isolating.
Besides being cheap, the hotel is close to the beach.
Beside being cheap, the hotel is close to the beach.
Besides of being cheap, the hotel is close to the beach.
items.why: **Besides** = кроме того; beside — «рядом»; of не нужен.

options: Not only she won, but she also broke the record.
Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
Not only she did win, but she also broke the record.
items.why: После Not only — инверсия (did she win).

options: Although it was cold, however we went swimming.
Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
items.why: Контраст выражается один раз: although **или** however / but, не оба.

options: Both the director and her deputy attended.
Both the director with her deputy attended.
Both the director or her deputy attended.
We were late. Therefore we missed the opening.
We were late, therefore we missed the opening.
We were late therefore, missed the opening.
items.why: Therefore — отдельное предложение (или точка с запятой); одна запятая не годится.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте несколькими связанными предложениями, используя линкеры из юнита.

items.prompt: Give one advantage and one drawback of living in a big city (on the one hand ... on the other hand).
items.sample: On the one hand, a big city offers more jobs. On the other hand, life there is noisy and expensive.

items.prompt: Describe your job or studies and add an extra fact with moreover / in addition.
items.sample: I work as an analyst. Moreover, I teach a course on data visualisation twice a week.

items.prompt: Describe a plan that did not work out and its consequence (as a result / consequently).
items.sample: Our train was cancelled. As a result, we arrived at the wedding two hours late.

items.prompt: Say something surprising that is contrary to what people think (on the contrary).
items.sample: People think I dislike mornings. On the contrary, I love getting up early.
